Subject: Audit logs / access logs — retention & export capabilities (initial)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. As part of our security review I need a short write-up on Redwood's audit and access log handling so we can sign off with our InfoSec team. Specifically we need to know: 

- How long audit logs (admin actions, console/API auth events) are retained in the hosted service by default, and whether that can be extended.
- Retention for request/access logs (API requests, prompt metadata) and whether token-level data is ever retained longer than the request.
- Export options: can we schedule recurring exports, export in bulk (CSV/JSON), stream to our SIEM (syslog/Kinesis), or point-to-S3?
- Deletion flow: if we ask for a data deletion (customer or account-level), how are audit/access logs handled? Any soft-delete window?

I attached our audit checklist. A concise answer that we can drop into our questionnaire is ideal.

Best,
Sara

Acme Corporation

Subject: Re: Audit logs / access logs — retention & export capabilities (technical details)

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. I pulled together the answers below; I'll also attach a small CSV example of an exported access log for format reference. Please let me know if you want field-level sample logs instead.

Summary (hosted / Dedicated / Private):
- Hosted (default): Audit logs (console admin actions, role changes, user invites) are retained 365 days by default for Business+ customers; 90 days for Starter. Access/request logs (API calls, request metadata excluding user-supplied input) are retained 90 days by default.
- Dedicated: Retention is configurable by contract — typical defaults are 365 days, but we can extend to multiyear with offsite archival.
- Private (VPC/on‑prem): Customer controls retention; Redwood provides tools to configure retention policies and lifecycle rules.

Export & streaming options:
- Console scheduled exports: Business++ and Dedicated customers can schedule daily/weekly exports to an S3 bucket (signed role), or to an Azure Blob container for EU/ACAP customers.
- API bulk export: We provide a /v1/audit-exports endpoint that can be used to kick off ad-hoc exports in CSV or NDJSON. Exports include standardized columns (timestamp, actor, action, target, request_id, ip, region, outcome).
- Streaming: We support streaming to customer SIEMs using either syslog (TLS) or Kinesis/Kafka connectors for Dedicated/private deployments. For hosted customers we offer a managed connector that pushes to a customer-controlled S3 or Kinesis stream.
- Direct integration: Customers can also configure webhook-style delivery for real-time admin events (low-volume) to an HTTPS endpoint.

Retention & deletion behavior:
- Deletion requests (account/user): When a deletion request is processed we apply a scoped removal flow. Customer content (prompts, model outputs) is removed per the data deletion request. Audit and access logs that reference an account are handled according to plan: for hosted customers we retain relevant audit records for the configured retention window to preserve security trail for compliance; PII in audit fields (e.g., user email) can be redacted on request if required by policy.
- Soft-delete window: We maintain a 30-day soft-delete for exported files and internal admin artifacts (to recover accidental deletions). Permanently purged logs are non-recoverable after the configured retention/soft-delete window.
- Encryption & key management: All logs are encrypted at rest; hosted encryption keys are managed by Redwood KMS. We support customer-managed keys (CMKs) for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Notes & limitations:
- Token-level data: We do not retain model token streams beyond transient processing unless customers opt into specialized audit capture; by default prompt content is not kept in access logs beyond what is required for debugging and billing and is subject to retention controls. If you need request/response storage for an extended period we recommend Dedicated/Private + archival export.
- Region residency: Exports will be placed in the region/bucket you specify; hosted default storage for US customers is in us-west-2. We can provide EU-hosted retention/export under the EU region offering.

Next steps:
- If you want, we can schedule a short technical session to walk your infra team through S3 role setup and a demo of the /v1/audit-exports API.

Regards,
